title: Arcane Impetus
summary: Arcane Impetus is an Arcane Enhancement for Warframes that increases  Ability Strength and  Ability Efficiency dependent on unique Status Effects from Abilities.
extract:
Arcane Impetus is an Arcane Enhancement for Warframes that increases  Ability Strength and  Ability Efficiency dependent on unique Status Effects from Abilities.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Eleanor of  The Hex for  7,500 at Rank 3 - 2-For-1.
Rewarded from the 1999 Calendar.
Rewarded from Techrot Safes in Höllvania missions.
Rewarded from Scaldra Caches in Höllvania Exterminate missions.
Dropped by the  H-09 Efervon Tank in Höllvania Assassination missions.
Rewarded from Höllvania Faceoff missions.
Dropped by the  Scaldra Screamer in Höllvania Stage Defense missions.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Abilities that apply any Status Effect will grant the  Ability Strength and  Ability Efficiency bonuses.
Buff is refreshed upon any damage from abilities.
Buff stacks for every Status Effect made by Abilities.
Statuses from  Sickening Pulse do not stack the buff; however, it can refresh the timer.
Unique "hidden" status effects such as  Knockdown do not stack the buff.
Buff is activated and/or refreshed by the following Companion Mods:  Coolant Leak,  Synergized Prospectus,  Reflex Denial,  Null Audit,  Arc Coil, and sometimes  Manifold Bond.
 Null Audit will only apply stacks from copied Blitz/Volatile and Jade Light Eximus abilities.
If  Manifold Bond applies a  Magnetic status effect and then that enemy's shields are depleted, the resulting  Electricity status effect will activate the buff.
Weapons and mods utilising Syndicate Radial Effects such as Blight, Entropy, Justice, Purity, Sequence and Truth can provide additional stacks.
If the 20 second timer expires without refreshing the buff, all stacks are lost.
The maximum realistic number of stacks for this Arcane is 14; This corresponds to an 84%  Ability Strength and a 42%  Ability Efficiency bonus with a fully-ranked Arcane.
The statuses that can be applied by abilities are  Impact,  Puncture,  Slash,  Heat,  Cold,  Electricity,  Toxin,  Blast,  Radiation,  Gas,  Corrosive,  Viral,  Magnetic, and  Void or  Tau.
 Void status effects are only possible with an Exalted Weapon and  Xata's Whisper.
 Tau status effects are mainly exclusive to  Caliban; note that  Sentient Wrath does not apply Tau status if infused into another Warframe.
In the Deepmines, it is also possible to apply  Tau status effects with non-melee exalted weapons by harvesting a  Vomval Trumpet, which only spawns in the Critter Liberation bounty.
Exalted Secondary weapons ( Dex Pixia,  Regulators, among others) can generate additional status effects via  Secondary Encumber.
Without utilizing the Helminth (thus excluding  Void), the maximum number of stacks is 13 stacks for 78%  Ability Strength and 39%  Ability Efficiency ( Bunraku,  Fangs of Raksh,  Damage Decoy, or Exalted Secondary weapons with  Secondary Encumber alone).

Tips
Warframes that can apply many different status types work particularly well with this Arcane, such as  Lavos,  Voruna,  Citrine,  Koumei, or  Zephyr's  Tornado.
Status effects generated via  Damage Decoy count towards this arcane's bonuses, and  Decoy can be infused onto any Warframe via the Helminth.
 Electricity status effects generated via  Magnetic count towards this arcane's bonuses, as long as the  Magnetic status was inflicted by an ability.
The bonus can be triggered regardless of if the target's Shields or  Overguard was broken by ability damage or weapon damage.
Since very few abilities can inflict  Magnetic status, this interaction mostly benefits Warframes with access to exalted weapons, such as  Excalibur,  Baruuk,  Mesa or  Cyte-09.
Exalted Weapons equipped with  Secondary Encumber can be used to quickly generate stacks for nuke skills (such as  Thermal Sunder).
Exalted Weapons equipped with  Melee Afflictions can be used as well, as status effects spread from this Arcane will count as Ability status effects.
Status effects redirected through  Trinity's  Link and  Nidus's  Parasitic Link will count as stacks for Impetus, as well as keeping the stacks refreshed. The amount of stacks gained depending on the elemental damage types able to be redirected on said map.
